is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus s.s. and Anopheles rivulorum.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports on insecticide susceptibility bioassays (WHO tube tests) but does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers (e.g., kdr, ace-1, etc.).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS counts or frequencies) are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the Gembe East area, Mbita District, Nyanza Province, Kenya.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study.

sub_country_location.evidence: Gembe East area, Mbita District, Nyanza Province, Kenya.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data for the reported bioassays are in the main text/figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the vectorial capacity and insecticide susceptibility of Anopheles rivulorum and Anopheles funestus s.s. in western Kenya. While it performs WHO tube bioassays to assess phenotypic resistance, it does not perform any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.
